scope: LOCAL ONLY: no VM, SSH, PHP, runtime, stage upload; no source/stage/ZIP edits

steps.result: independent read-only ZIP/stage/matrix check, all matched

verified: Matrix is 88 rows = R3 native83 96 minus 8 cachefix; 44 per variant (18 roundtrip/malformed/invalid-utf8, 18 reads by original83-r2/candidate83-r2/original74, 8 filesystem cache); order equals R3 inventory.

22 source files per variant read from the actual pinned exp12/exp13 ZIPs, each byte-identical to the R3 closure and to the local stage; 4 candidate files differ from original (Credentials, NullCredentials, AbstractCredentialsDecorator, FileCache).

Stage inventory equals manifest (48 files + identities.json); no cachefix sources; probe.php, cache-probe.php and reference-wires.json byte-identical to R3 pins and not duplicated in tracked sources (stage/ is gitignored).
run.sh differs from reviewed run-r2.sh only by phase/path and removal of the baseline74 branch and cachefix variant; sandbox, pre/post manifest and runtime checks unchanged.
Current83 read rows consume wires produced by this run (roundtrips precede reads); original74 reads and cache read-C/read-O use explicitly pinned historical inputs.

compare() injects 38 historical74 and 8 historical cachefix83 rows only in memory into the unchanged pinned reconcile-r3 oracle; only counts/check labels are exported; report states 88 new processes, rows NOT_RERUN, no 134-pass claim.
Rollback incompatibility explicit: oracle requires original readers to reject candidate O wires; report fixes rollback_compatible:false and application_acceptance:false.

Collector retains per-row command, input hash, integer exit, raw base64 and decoded channels, timeout/launch errors and failures; rejects bool exits, invalid UTF-8 output, probe/loaded drift; collector closure is rechecked after the run; oracle modules are pinned by input-pins and loaded from their own directory (no common/report_contract name collision).
caveats_non_blocking: collect.py must be run from the repository root: reconcile-r3.py resolves its evidence path relative to CWD; from another CWD compare() raises FileNotFoundError (OSError, not caught) after the 88 processes and the report would not be written.
Only ValueError/KeyError/TypeError are caught around compare(); any other exception type there would also lose the in-memory observations before write.
Runtime PHP identity is pinned to R3 native83 runtime_files; if the VM runtime changed since R3, run.sh pre-verify will fail closed (detected, not a pass).
Adapter tests replay historical rows as synthetic input; they validate plumbing only, not native execution.
readiness: READY for stage.py + 88 native83 processes only after explicit exclusive native83 grant from the coordinator, run from repository root with new output names.
limitations: No SSH config, VM state or remote path availability was checked.
